items.title: What Is Next For Global Payments (GPN) After Elliott Pressure And Authentication Upgrade?
items.summary: Global Payments (NYSE:GPN) is under pressure from Elliott Investment Management, which has taken an activist stake and is questioning the rationale for the Worldpay acquisition. Elliott is pushing Global Payments' board for greater disclosure around capital allocation decisions tied to the Worldpay deal and related integration plans. items.title: Global Payments (GPN) Stock May Look Reasonable As Buyout Talks Pause
items.summary: Global Payments has had a mixed share price journey in recent years, yet the stock is still ahead by 25.6% over the past 12 months, which puts fresh attention on what investors are paying for each dollar of its sales. With private equity interest cooling and the Worldpay acquisition bedding in, the key question now is how well the current share price lines up with the company’s revenue base.
